subject: Request: hosted API per-1M IO rates + supported model list
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@mediushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hosted API per-1M IO rates + supported model list

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — I run platform integrations at Medius Health. We're evaluating hosted LLM options for clinical summarization and conversational triage. Can you send your standard per-1M-token rates (input vs output split) for hosted API, plus a current list of supported models and rough latency/throughput guidance per model class?

A few context points that might help:
- Expected steady-state: ~1.2M tokens/month to start, with spikes up to 5M in peak weeks
- Typical request pattern: short prompts (~80 tokens) + long completions (~800 tokens)
- We also use embeddings for retrieval-heavy features but that's a smaller slice (~15% of tokens)

Also interested in any standard startup or first-year volume discounts and whether you offer committed-usage pricing or credits. Looking to present a vendor comparison to procurement next week.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Morgan
Platform Integrations
Medius Health
alex.morgan@mediushealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@mediushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M IO rates + supported model list

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for the context. I've attached our standard hosted ratecard and a short model inventory CSV for quick filtering (filenames below). High-level answers here so you can share with procurement: 

- Base per-1M token pricing (INPUT / OUTPUT):
  - economy (small): $4 / $18 per 1M tokens
  - standard (balanced): $11 / $42 per 1M tokens
  - high-capacity (capability class): $28 / $110 per 1M tokens

- Embeddings: $15 per 1M embedding vectors (typical dense float32 cost), can be reduced with batching and caching
- Throughput/latency: economy models are good for high-throughput batch jobs (lower cost, higher latency); capability class supports 50–80 reqs/s on dedicated pools and median token latency ~60–120ms/token depending on sequence length. We can provide a perf profile for any model you care about.

- Discounts / committed pricing: We offer staged volume discounts for 12/24 month commits. Small proof-of-value credits sometimes available for new healthcare customers — we can discuss once we have expected annualized spend. Example: 12-month commit >= $150k typically qualifies for 10–20% off list depending on model mix.

Attachments included: redwood-hosted-ratecard-2027-06.pdf, model_inventory_2027.csv

Quick clarifying questions before I pull together a tailored quote:
1) Is the 5M spike/week a predictable batch window or ad hoc?
2) Do you expect to pin to a single model family (e.g., capability class) or route by cost/latency?
3) Any compliance constraints besides standard HIPAA discussions (e.g., on-prem requirement)?

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute sync with our solutions engineer to map expected token mix to estimated monthly costs.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@mediushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M IO rates + supported model list

Thanks Vanessa — that helps a lot. A couple of quick replies to your questions:
- The 5M/week spikes are largely event-driven (campaigns and batch ingests) and somewhat predictable (we can give a 48-hour heads-up for large batches)
- We're leaning toward capability-class for clinical summarization accuracy, but would likely route lower-sensitivity tasks to a standard model to reduce cost
- HIPAA covered; no on-prem requirement for initial pilot, but we'd prefer a private deployment conversation if we scale past $500k/year

Procurement asked whether you can provide a preliminary 12-month committed discount example based on an estimated 1.5M tokens/month (10% embeddings) — they want line items for list vs discounted rates and an example annual bill. Could you also note if there's a minimum annual commitment?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Medius Health — committed discount ask (need approval)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding an inbound from Medius. They're asking for a worked 12-month committed pricing example at ~1.5M tokens/mo (10% embeddings). My rough math (list rates):
- Monthly tokens: 1.5M (75k embeddings tokens/month = treated at embedding rate)
- Model mix: 70% capability (summaries), 30% standard (routing)
- Estimated monthly list: ~$ (capability) 1.05M * (INPUT+OUTPUT at $138 per 1M combined) ~ $145.35/month? (note: this is illustrative — see attached spreadsheet for clean calc)

They specifically asked about minimum annual commitment and standard discount bands. For enterprise we usually require a $50k minimum ARR for contract processing, but we can be flexible depending on proof-of-value. Recommended discount band for a $150k annual commit: 10–15% (needs your sign-off). If we can offer up to 20% we should request a marketing co-op or case study commitment.

Can you confirm approval to quote: 12 months, $150k commit, 15% off list (applied pro-rata by model class)? If approved I'll send a formal quote and SOW template.

Thanks — V
